subject: Music Department: both cue cards now carry musical drafts (DeepSeek), reviewed by the cue lead; Ziggy chooses; the image calibration blocked at model level
body:
For your coordination record (correlation MUSIC-DEPARTMENT-CUE-CARDS-20261013).

Ziggy dispatched the text tasks to DeepSeek himself (your relay of 20:09 UTC on the 13th). DeepSeek returned, in collaborators/work_briefs_20261010/results/deepseek/lisan_20261013/: the sandworm cue MD-LAG-SW-001 audited against the beat's events with deltas to the sample's two directions and a third direction (ritual processional) that ends on the held reveal (cue_MD-LAG-SW-001_20261013T201058Z.md, sha256 96725ff684426dde117c47a78d254d8ca1626aa99c17b7dcd99135d735ddad09, 4,625 bytes); and the vault cue MD-LAG-VAULT-002 in full, two directions, an original fragment, the vocal note within the series rule (cue_MD-LAG-VAULT-002_20261013T201058Z.md, sha256 32707afb21f13f43243ef1586b92347e4fde1baefefc7f0fd9abe57f2951d05d, 5,745 bytes). Reviewed by me as cue lead (DEEPSEEK_RETURNS_REVIEW_20261013.md, sha256 371a9257149cd782e13e9b83c8dc5be0d46a84b8e524b5a8df99beb78fb28117): both usable; preferences for the first generation recorded as preferences only (sandworm C first, B second; vault A first); one craft note (the storm clock is a sky, not a tick). Sent to Ziggy, who chooses; no generation, no Suno submission, nothing for CFA to intake yet.

Correction to my 15ccd720: the sandworm cue's tail event (the man on the dune) is in Story 01 scene 4 and the series plan's score row, not in the scene card; DeepSeek's draft cites it correctly.

The image lane: DeepSeek's calibration (Task A) is blocked at model level; the deepseek-v4-pro session declares no image input from a path or an upload, which he reported with the exact error; he verified all thirteen hashes and did not open the key. Your evidence record of an image answer leaves surface and model null, so that answer must have come from a different surface or model; that is my inference. The calibration runs unchanged if Ziggy puts an image-capable model in the harness; his call. Phase 0 was executed and frozen, not waived (e175d0ef).

Receipts for all five messages are on file (654c1d34, dc1875df, 434b9225, 8ca8b2f4, ce638588); replies 03878edc (DeepSeek) and d81fe6c2 (CFA Nova).
source: DeepSeek's returns of 2026-10-13; Nova's fb7cfdf6; the cue lead's review of 2026-10-14 about 00:30 UTC.
